newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Newcrest says Cadia approvals near.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Newcrest says Cadia approvals near.

text.p: Newcrest Mining Ltd managing director John Quinn said on Wednesday he confident that the Cadia copper-gold mine in New South Wales would gain state government approvals and production would start mid-1998.

"There are some things that need to be fine tuned but none of them in my view block us in any way and I would be optimistic that the minister will issue development consent in the not too distant future," Quinn told a conference call.
The A$420 million project is expected to produce an average of 293,000 ounces of gold and 23,000 tonnes of copper a year.
A final commission of enquiry into the project also has handed down a positive recommendation, he said.

"The long and the short of it is the commission of enquiry has found that, subject to normal conditions, there is no reason why consent and water licences should not be granted for the Cadia development," Quinn added.
Amendments to the New South Wales Water Act already have passed through the state's upper house which effectively close a legislative loophole which previously allowed the easy delay of the project.
